content: Consider how a Hash Map can store the complement of each element (target - current) as you traverse the array in one pass.
For each element nums[i], check if (target - nums[i]) already exists in the map. If yes, you found the two indices in O(N) time and O(N) space.
Find the first pair from the right where nums[i] < nums[i + 1]. This identifies the pivot that needs to increase.
From the right end, find the smallest number greater than nums[i] and swap them. Then reverse the subarray after index i to minimize the next permutation.
The water trapped above any bar is determined by min(max_left, max_right) - height[i]. Can you maintain these boundary maximums with two pointers?
